title: Week 6 Cheat Sheet: GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT

items.label: Why naive fails
items.note: No canonical node order: $|V|!$ orderings give different inputs for the same graph.

items.label: Invariant / equivariant
items.note: Graph→vector: invariant. Graph→matrix: equivariant (output permutes with input).

items.label: GCN layer
items.note: Average neighbours (×$W_k$) + self ($B_k$), non-linearity; $k$ layers ⇒ $k$ hops.

items.label: Training
items.note: Supervised: cross-entropy. Unsupervised: similar nodes ↔ similar embeddings with dot-product decoder.

items.label: Inductive
items.note: Shared parameters ⇒ embeddings for unseen nodes/graphs.

items.label: General framework
items.note: Layer = Message + Aggregation; also layer connectivity, graph augmentation, learning objective.

items.label: GraphSAGE
items.note: AGG ∈ {mean, pool, LSTM on shuffled neighbours}; concatenate with own embedding.

items.label: GAT
items.note: Learned weights: score, softmax over neighbours, weighted aggregation.

items.label: Multi-head
items.note: Several attention replicas; concatenate or sum; stabilises learning.

items.label: Attention benefits
items.note: Parallel over edges, sparse, localised, fixed parameter count ⇒ inductive.
